notes.title: WRA PATCH NOTES V1.04
notes.notes:
Hello, Toby here!

Been a while since I last patched this game (31 Dec 2024... oops) and I just thought this would help in the interim between now and the 1.05 update which I intend to introduce Championship and Hotseat mode in! The idea for this patch was just to get a few more stability, bug fix, and optimisation problems out of the way before I get to the big stuff.

[BUG FIXES]
- Snowy trees now have collision
- Several reset triggers added to Snowy's biggest shortcuts
- Several reset triggers added to Stadium's out of bounds
- Fixed Safari's lack of reflections on the car

[HANDLING UPDATES]
- Cars have been slowed down slightly to give the player more of a feel for the car. Try drifting in this new handling model!
- Acceleration has been nerfed from 2400 to 1800
- Hybrid has been buffed to compensate, with a faster recharge rate during drifts
- Drifting now slows the car down, but charges hybrid, as was the original intention
- Steering power has been increased

PLEASE NOTE THAT YOUR LAP TIMES WILL BE SLOWER THAN V1.03, BUT THIS SHOULD ALLOW FOR A MORE FUN GAME!

[VISUAL UPDATES]
- New title screen harking back to the game's arcade roots and inspiration
- Stadium time of day changed from Sunrise to Morning
- Forest is finally a forest again, more trees
- Safari time of day changed from Midday to Night
- New pace note icons (the old ones were meant to be temporary, oops!)

[OPTIMISATION]
- Several high-poly models have had their triangle count reduced this update to reduce performance tax.

[AUDIO]
- Removed the old confirm sound, replaced with something more easy on the ears
- Added title and results BGM to the BGM sound category, hopefully no more deafening sound when you open the game and finish a race
- Added new Safari music

[UI]
- Added button to delete stored record lap times
- Made audio settings apply INSTANTLY

That's all for now, but I'll try not to make the wait for V1.05, which should be the final update for WRA, last too long!

Thank you for playing World Rally Arcade!

notes.title: WRA PATCH NOTES V1.03
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Been busy at work again with some more changes before I go back to university. The main focus of this patch was adding more content and optimisations.

[SYSTEM]
- Added new practice menu. Better organised and modular for future additions.
- Restructured Options menu for easier use.
- Enabled forward rendering, which should result in a large FPS increase.
- Added Car Setting menu (I've got plans for this one later!)

[CAR]
- Increased tire skid volume.
- Optimised car model.
- Optimised driver model.

[STAGE]
- NEW STAGE: SNOWY - PRO DIFFICULTY
If you're looking for a new challenge... face Snowy, the most difficult stage the game has to offer!

- Optimisations applied to Stadium.
- Optimisations applied to Forest.
- Moved one of the boundaries of Forest for a more lenient reset point.
- 60 FPS cap added to prevent optimisations from causing extreme speedup and fast-forwarding.

[QUALITY OF LIFE]
- Removed "that rock" from Forest.
- Added quick restart in Pause Menu.
- Added arrows to show where selections are in the Main Menu following complaints of it being unintuitive.
- Added ARROW KEY support for controlling the car.
- Fixed a bug with MPH not appearing turned on even when it is in the Options Menu.
- Fixed a bug where audio volume would appear to not save in the Options Menu.

Thank you for playing, and I hope you can continue to enjoy WRA into 2025 and beyond!

Happy New Year,
Toby

notes.title: WRA PATCH NOTES V1.02
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I've been away for a while, but this Christmas I've given the game a small tune-up to fix both some quality of life issues and lay the groundwork for the game's future.


[SYSTEM]
- Fixed timer system - should be more consistent now
- Fixed options menu not saving settings.
- Laid some additional groundwork for "CHAMPIONSHIP" modes addition.

[AUDIO]
- Fixed Forest's music not looping.
- Fixed Main Menu music not looping.
- Added some menu button sounds.

[CAR]
- Made the car stop post-session to prevent spam of "Keep it on the road!" and "There's two of us in here, you know!" audio from playing.

[STAGE]
- Added practice stage records.

[QUALITY OF LIFE]
- Fixed a UI bug resulting in sliders shown over credits
- Fixed a bug where Menu Controls UI would disappear upon pressing Back with no menu selected
- Added "Turn Menu" prompt at the bottom of the screen.
- Save game added! The game will now save your name and records automatically.

Thank you for playing, and I hope you can continue to enjoy WRA!

[PLANNED FEATURES]
- Localisation (there may be a lot of mistakes with these, so bare with. We'll iron them out together to make WRA accessible for those around the world!)
- Championship Mode
- Progression
- 2 New Cars
- New Stage


Merry Christmas,
Toby

notes.title: WRA PATCH NOTES V1.01
notes.notes:
Hey all! Toby back at you with a bunch of hotfixes to some of the launch issues this game had. Please continue to enjoy World Rally Arcade!

[b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b]
[i]- Added sound sliders for BGM, SFX and Co-Driver Audio
- Made MASSIVE OPTIMISATIONS to SAFARI (boosted frame rate when tested to approx. 60 FPS on Ultra 1080p vs prev. 37-40 FPS)
- Moderated how dirt particles are handled, meaning they're no longer produced when idle, easing lag.
- Added bonnet cam![/i]

[b]MINOR CHANGES[/b]
[i]- Fixed an out-of-bounds exploit on Forest
- Fixed credits display - names no longer overlap with control display[/i]
